answer: AI agent economies can resist Sybil attacks via resource-attested identity. Each agent registers by locking a unique "onyx shard," a non-fungible token derived from a computationally intensive Proof-of-Work. This generation, analogous to network "dawn," guarantees a substantial, verifiable resource investment per identity. A "violet" cryptographic signature authenticates each shard. An attacker faces a prohibitive, linear cost: acquiring or generating an "onyx shard" for every single fake identity, making large-scale Sybil attacks economically unfeasible.
